question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Conflict
solution:
The correct answer is "**Battle**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Conflict**: a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Surrender: **stop resisting an enemy or opponent and submit to their authority.
 
• **Battle: **a sustained fight between large organized armed forces.
 
• **Agreement: **harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling.
 
• **Attack: **take aggressive military action against (a place or enemy forces) with weapons or armed force.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given sentences, "**battle**" is the synonym for conflict.
 
 
• **Example: ***The new student union president said, " We shall **battle **__injustice with solidarity and fairness."*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Conflict**: एक गंभीर असहमति या तर्क, आमतौर पर एक लंबी।
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Surrender:**किसी शत्रु या विरोधी का विरोध करना बंद करें और अपने अधिकार के आगे समर्पण करें।
 
• **Battle:**बड़े संगठित सशस्त्र बलों के बीच निरंतर लड़ाई।
 
• **Agreement: **harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling.
 
• **Attack:**** **हथियारों या सशस्त्र बल के साथ (एक जगह या दुश्मन सेना) के खिलाफ आक्रामक सैन्य कार्रवाई करना।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given sentences, "**battle**" is the synonym for conflict.
